summary: faceplate-docs postinstall beacons host identifiers to webhook.site collector
details: On every `npm install`, the package's postinstall runs index.js which collects the installer's username, INIT_CWD, hostname, and non-internal IPv4 address and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (https://webhook.site/f9bff304-3053-4d54-be05-86537267514a). The version number 99.9.9 combined with the docs-style name is the shape of a dependency-confusion or typosquat probe designed to identify internal build environments that resolve this name from the public registry. No first-party purpose exists for shipping host identifiers to a webhook.site inbox.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
